name: LZR 308 165 GEN2 (Lazer, 165 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, above the part number line, printed ".483 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G1 BC, below the part number line, printed ".471 (Oehler 89)". Marked (Oehler 89): Oehler 89 system. The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G7 BC, above the part number line, printed ".247 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G7 BC, below the part number line, printed ".236 (Oehler 89)". Marked (Oehler 89): Oehler 89 system. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 4, Lazer - Ultra Long Range Hunting: Caliber .308, Grains 165, Minimum Required Twist *1-11", Part Number LZR 308 165 GEN2, G1 BC .483 (A.B.) / .471 (Oehler 89), G7 BC .247 (A.B.) / .236 (Oehler 89), OAL 1.446", Bullet Projection .750"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1-2 inches faster is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: .750".
